description: LP contracts §2 — a QUOTED literal. The user's one way of saying 'take this string as typed', and the door's answer must show it was taken that way: the lattice carries one VERBATIM value with the §1.4 text, NOTHING is proposed or bound for the quoted span (not the n-gram floor, not a member that reads alike), and — on an estate whose model has not declared which column carries the name — the value is emitted unattributed with a G3 gap rather than attributed to a column nobody named. Refuse over guess, applied to a span the user already explained.
